
 ◇ susynth › ? Help · ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll
 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      PAGES                                                                                                                                                   █
      m                      the pages pop-up beside the icons: ↑↓ choose, Enter open, m or Esc close                                                         █
  ▶   In the editor on Play, m types the letter: press Esc m there.                                                                                           █
  ≡   Esc f  /  Esc b        next / previous page                                                                                                             █
  ●   Esc                    from any page, back to Play                                                                                                      █
  ♪   For Esc keys, press Esc, then the key within 1.5 s, or hold Alt.                                                                                        █
  ⚙   KEYS ON EACH PAGE                                                                                                                                       █
  ?   Sets                   ↑↓ select · Enter load · a add to the set list · n new · d delete (asks first)                                                   █
  ◈   Recordings             ↑↓ select · Enter show the path · d delete (asks first)                                                                          █
  ▮   Sounds                 ↑↓ select · ←→ fold a group · Enter preview or fold · i insert the example                                                       █
      Settings               ↑↓ select · ←→ change · Enter edit or reload where it says so                                                                    █
      Help                   ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll                                                                                                              █
      Perform                Enter go live · i mix in · Esc n / Esc p next / previous · [ ] reorder · d remove                                                █
                                                                                                                                                              █
      PLAYING                                                                                                                                                 █
      ^E                     run the block under the cursor (the whole live_loop; ┊ marks it)                                                                 █
      Esc Enter              run the whole buffer, like Sonic Pi's Run                                                                                        █
      ^G                     stop every live_loop and thread, like Sonic Pi's Stop                                                                            █
      ^P                     stop, or run the whole buffer again                                                                                              █
      ^R                     start / stop recording a WAV                                                                                                     │
      ^S  ^O                 save / load a set by name (sets are .rb files)                                                                                   │
      Esc u  n               mute / unmute track n — a digit alone does nothing                                                                               │
      Esc k  n               stop that track (Enter stops the loop under the cursor)                                                                          │
      Esc s  n               solo track n (0 clears)                                                                                                          │
      Esc l                  session log (errors, puts, cue) in the right pane; Alt+↑↓ scrolls                                                                │
      Esc - / =              level of the live_loop the cursor is in                                                                                          │
      Esc , / .              close / open a filter on the live_loop the cursor is in (Esc < / > in big steps)                                                 │
      Ctrl+↑↓                nudge the number under the cursor; while playing it is heard on the next beat                                                    │
      Shift+Ctrl+↑↓ moves it 10×. Esc ↑ / Esc ↓ do the same where Ctrl+↑↓ is taken (macOS).                                                                   │
      Esc r                  switch the right-hand pane between Tracks and the piano roll                                                                     │
      Esc m                  the pages pop-up; the Mixer page is Sonic Pi's master mixer (volume, drive, filters, mono, limiter)                              │
      Esc t / a              next theme / next audio output                                                                                                   │
      Esc x                  export the set as a MIDI file (runs silently in a second sandbox)                                                                │
      Esc n / p              perform: next / previous set in the set list                                                                                     │
      Esc i                  mix in the next set: it starts muted on the next bar, beside what plays                                                          │
      Esc o                  fade out the old set over 2 bars, then stop it                                                                                   │
      ^Q                     quit (asks first if there are unsaved changes)                                                                                   │
                                                                                                                                                              │
      EDITING                                                                                                                                                 │
  ● play   ● 60 bpm · bar 1 · ●○○○   ○ rec off
  ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll   m pages   ^Q quit
